master_gate.title: Auto-print setting
master_gate.off: Auto-print is turned off, so tickets will not print by themselves.
master_gate.guide: Open printer settings and turn on auto-print for the counter POS.

poller_alive.title: Printing POS response
poller_alive.never: No device has been seen printing yet for this store.
poller_alive.silent: The printing POS has not responded for {{sinceLastPollSec}} seconds — check that its app or browser is open.
poller_alive.guide: Make sure the counter POS that prints is powered on with its app or browser open.

stuck_tickets.title: Stuck unprinted orders
stuck_tickets.found: {{n}} order(s) older than {{olderThanMin}} minutes are still waiting to print.
stuck_tickets.guide: Clear the stuck tickets, then check that the printer is working.

station_drift.title: Kitchen printer assignment
station_drift.unassigned: These kitchens have no printer assigned: {{unassigned}}. Their items fall through to the first printer.
station_drift.guide: Set up a printer for each kitchen, or use the one-tap setup below.

recent_failures.title: Recent print failures
recent_failures.count: {{n}} print(s) failed in the last {{hours}} hours.

device_reports_fresh.title: Printing POS check-in
device_reports_fresh.none: No printing device has checked in for this store yet.
device_reports_fresh.stale: The printing POS has not checked in recently — it may be closed or offline.

role_identity.title: This device's role
role_identity.displayCause: This device ({{label}}) does not print — it only shows orders. The printing POS handles tickets.

bridge_or_qz.title: Printing connection
bridge_or_qz.qzFail: The printing app (QZ Tray) is not running or not reachable on this PC.
bridge_or_qz.nativeFail: This device's printing service did not respond. Restart the app.
bridge_or_qz.rawbtUnknown: Printing goes through the RawBT app, which cannot be checked automatically. Use a test print to confirm.
bridge_or_qz.guide: Make sure the printing app is installed and running, then run the check again.

printers_visible.title: Printer detection
printers_visible.missing: These printers are not in this device's printer list: {{missingList}}.
printers_visible.noList: This device's printer list could not be read, so printer names could not be confirmed.
printers_visible.guide: Check the printer power and cable, and confirm the name matches the one in the printer settings.

cert_trusted.title: Trusted printing
cert_trusted.fail: Printing may show an "Allow this print?" pop-up because it is not trusted yet.
cert_trusted.guide: Reinstall the printer setup file so printing is trusted with no pop-up.

settings_sync.title: Settings sync
settings_sync.drift: This device's saved printer settings differ from the store's settings.
settings_sync.guide: Reload the page so this device picks up the store's saved printer settings.

print_format_fit.title: Print format
print_format_fit.info: Print format is set to "{{format}}". If tickets come out blank, try both a text test print and an image test print to see which works.
print_format_fit.guide: Use the test prints below (text and image) to find which format your printer supports.

test_print.title: Actual paper output
test_print.prompt: The actual printout cannot be detected automatically. Use a test print to confirm.

panel.title: Printer self-check
panel.desc: Run one check to see what is wrong and how to fix it.
panel.error: The check could not run. Check the connection and try again.
panel.testModalDesc: Print a test and tell us if paper came out. This is the only way to confirm the actual printout.
panel.testRecordedFail: Recorded — please check the printer power, paper and cable.
panel.testError: Could not send the test print.

admin.title: Print Health
admin.subtitle: Printing status across all stores. Click a store for device and check details.

drill.title: Details
drill.noDevices: No devices have reported yet. Ask the store to open the POS.
drill.guideStore: To run device checks, ask the store to open Settings > Printer and tap Run full check.
